title: The FTC says Shutterstock will pay $35M to settle charges that Shutterstock misled consumers about its subscription plans and made it too difficult to cancel (Jonathan Stempel/Reuters)
summary: Jonathan Stempel / Reuters: The FTC says Shutterstock will pay $35M to settle charges that Shutterstock misled consumers about its subscription plans and made it too difficult to cancel — Shutterstock (SSTK.N) will pay $35 million to settle U.S. Federal Trade Commission charges that the online provider of stock photography …
